title: Legal PA
description:
Legal Personal Assistant

Salary: 30,000 - 32,000 (dependant on experience)

Ref: BCR/MG/32607

Location: Birmingham

Bell Cornwall Recruitment are delighted to be recruiting for a proactive and professional Legal Personal Assistant to join their award-winning law firm, in Birmingham!

This is an excellent opportunity to become part of a dynamic and collaborative legal team, working alongside talented Solicitors in a supportive environment that values teamwork and professional development.

The key responsibilities include:
- Building and maintaining strong relationships with internal and external clients.
- Managing Solicitors' diaries, coordinating meetings and arranging appointments.
- Handling incoming calls, emails, post and voicemail, ensuring queries are prioritised and responded to promptly.
- Preparing, formatting and proofreading legal documents, correspondence and reports, ensuring accuracy and consistency.
- Liaising with Solicitors to coordinate priorities, manage deadlines and provide efficient administrative support.

The ideal candidate will have:
- Essential: Previous experience as a Legal Personal Assistant / Legal PA / Legal Secretary
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook and Word.
- A proactive, detail-oriented and professional approach, with the ability to work effectively within a team.

title: Team Assistant
description:
Team Assistant

Salary: 25,000 - 26,000 (dependant on experience)

Ref: BCR/JN/32608

Location: Birmingham

Bell Cornwall Recruitment are seeking for a highly organised and proactive Team Assistant to provide administrative support for a corporate team within a regional law firm.

This is an excellent opportunity to enhance your diary management skills as well as your legal secretary skills within the legal sector.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Act as a key point of contact between the team and external clients.
- Manage diary appointments and meeting schedules.
- Provide high-quality administrative and organisational support.
- Organise internal meetings, record meetings and actions from meetings.
- Prepare correspondence and documents through audio, copy typing and verbal instruction.

The successful candidate should have:
- Strong diary management skills.
- Previous legal dictation experience.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
- A proactive and professional approach.

If you are looking for an opportunity to develop your legal secretarial skills as a Team Assistant in Birmingham, apply here today to find out more!
